issue_context.title: SetWarmup Throws Exception When Not Called in Initialize
issue_context.body:
#### Expected Behavior
Notify users that `QCAlgorithm.SetWarmup` cannot be used after initialization. 

#### Actual Behavior
`QCAlgorithm.SetWarmup` can be called after initialization which doesn't do any warm up.

#### Potential Solution
Throw exception if `SetWarmup` is called when `IsWarmingUp` has already been flipped to `false`. The message should tell the user that this method should be called in `Initialize` only.

#### Reproducing the Problem
Call `SetWarmup` in `OnData`.

#### Checklist
- [x] I have completely filled out this template
- [x] I have confirmed that this issue exists on the current `master` branch
- [x] I have confirmed that this is not a duplicate issue by searching [issues](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/issues)

review_comments: A separate issue, but starting to think this end state should probably be owned by the algorithm itself, not this 3rd party 🤔
I could see that, maybe we should consider extending the IRegressionAlgorithmDefinition interface to contain a member for expected status?
